summary.en: RSF drone strikes have hit Darfur markets, killing more than 100 civilians and have also struck a power station, cutting electricity to two states. The Sudanese army is accused of launching 162 drone attacks from Ethiopian territory, while Ethiopia denies involvement. Women are increasingly serving as frontline responders as the siege worsens and civilian arrests rise. Nearly 120,000 people have been displaced in Blue Nile state since January, according to a UN agency. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: RSF-militsen har gjennom droneangrep rammet markeder i Darfur, drept mer enn 100 sivile og også truffet en kraftstasjon, som har kuttet strømmen til to delstater. Den sudanske hæren (SAF) blir anklaget for å ha gjennomført 162 droneangrep fra etiopisk territorium, mens Etiopia benekter involvering. Kvinner fungerer i økende grad som frontlinje-respondenter etter hvert som beleiringen forverres og antallet sivile arrestasjoner øker. Nesten 120 000 personer har blitt fordrevet i delstaten Blue Nile siden januar, ifølge en FN-byrå. Konflikten forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
